title: Vivid BAD SQUAD Chapter1 Episode17 The Third

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I have no intention of singing with Akito again.
There's no big reason behind it, though.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But...you always look like you're having so much fun when you sing with him...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Really? I look like I'm having fun?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What, you didn't even realize it?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
To be honest, you never show much emotion.
It makes it hard to tell what you're thinking.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But that's not the case when you're up there with Akito. I can always tell you're having fun.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: ...Sorry, but I've got somewhere to be.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey! You said you were free a minute ago!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: There was a time when I didn't think I'd be able to perform at an event again because I wasn't as serious about all this as the rest of you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I realized that no matter what anybody told me, what I really wanted was to get back up there with An and sing!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What is it that you really want, Aoyagi?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Maybe I went a little too far...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I'm not so sure about that.
Besides, thanks to you, I think I understand him a little better.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm starting to realize he's just as stubborn as a certain other person we know.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I don't know what's going on with him, but I hope he learns to be a little more honest with himself.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So what do you want to do? You gonna give up?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I want to try a bit more...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I thought you might say that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I think this calls for a strategy meeting, then.
I'll help you see this through to the end.

rows.Speaker: New Staff
rows.Line:
Akito, you've been doing a lot of solo shows lately.
Has Toya been sick or something?

rows.Speaker: Experienced Staff
rows.Line:
Don't bother him about it.
Even the most serious musicians reach a point in their careers sooner or later.

rows.Speaker: Experienced Staff
rows.Line: Hey, have you confirmed the slots for tomorrow yet?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
This isn't the time to be worrying about him.
I have to keep moving forward if I'm going to surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
My next show is...the day after tomorrow.
I need to figure out what I'm playing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Where am I? What's going on? I don't recognize this place.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh? Is the other one not with you?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh well, this makes three!
Come on, we've got to let Miku and MEIKO know!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: H-Hey! What's going on here?! Stop pulling me!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: How do you know my name?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Welcome. So you finally noticed, then.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So you've finally come. How lovely.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hatsune Miku is here too?
I must be hallucinating. I didn't realize I was that tired.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hey, we're no hallucination.
You're Akito of BAD DOGS, aren't you?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You sing with your friend, Toya...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That guy's no friend of mine!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Man... I don't know what's going on here, but Toya and I no longer have anything to do with each other.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It sounds like something happened between the two of them.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
For now, why don't you have a seat?
You look simply exhausted.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Why would I hang around when I don't even know what's going on?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
How about one cup of coffee, then?
The cheesecake is pretty good as well.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Sometimes it's best to talk things out, don't you think?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
When did it get this late?
I've got to start getting the bar ready soon.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, you're right. I should probably get going.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Hm? Sorry, but we're not quite open yet.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Hey there, Toya. You want your usual coffee?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I... just came to say goodbye to Ken.
